name: radiopirata
description: Explorar emisoras reales del mundo y escucharlas con pocos pasos.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
